content: @github/copilot-sdk 1.0.14 (GA 2026-06-02; Node ^20.19||>=22.12; MIT). JSON-RPC control of bundled Copilot CLI runtime (platform packages, COPILOT_CLI_PATH override). CopilotClient.createSession({model, tools:[defineTool(name,{...zod})], mcpServers:{local stdio|http}, systemMessage:{mode:'replace'|'customize'|append, content}, onPermissionRequest}); events assistant.message_delta, session.idle, session.compaction_complete (token counts). Available to all Copilot subscribers incl. free tier, plus BYOK. No per-turn usage/cost event documented (premium-request billing).
